name: Citrusdal Mountain
terroir: Piekenierskloof is a high mountain ward on the N7 between Citrusdal and Clanwilliam, its old bush vines planted on sandy loam at 620-780m — among the highest-altitude vineyard sites in the Western Cape (multiple sources). Six van Zyl family vineyards (Bergendal and Heidedal farms) date 1962-1976 and meet Old Vine Project criteria;
